name: Enthalpy v0.4.35
notes:
# Enthalpy v0.4.35

## Changes

- Notes now has quick links for each top-level workspace location.
- The Notes file list shows one selected location at a time and can filter its
  files by name or path.
- Open notes now show a document outline for fast heading navigation.
- Daily context markers now appear as readable Project or Area chips in the
  Live Markdown editor.

## Test this preview

Open Notes and select Inbox, Daily, Projects, Areas, Resources, Archive, or
Assets. Confirm that the file list shows the selected location. Filter the
list, then open a matching note.

Open a note with headings and use the outline to move between them. Open a
Daily note with Project or Area sections and confirm that its context markers
appear as readable chips.

## Known limits

This is a limited preview. Hosted Sync is not available. Work stays on this
device.
